messages:
arun: Quick sync on INC-4321 postmortem follow-ups. Need a concise playbook for external comms + clear owners for remediation tracking. Main things: status page text, customer-facing summary template, who gets full RCA and when, and an explicit owner for each action item. Can we lock this now?

lina: I can author the status page blurb and a short FAQ entry for the public post. Will keep it <3 lines and link to the PM. Planning to publish within 90 minutes after sign-off.

sam: i'll take the customer-facing summaries for impacted accounts. Plan: two tiers: (A) all impacted customers get a 1-paragraph summary same day; (B) enterprise/regulatory customers get an expanded report after review. I need the impacted list from support.

support-bot: SUP-1156 created to collect impacted accounts for INC-4321. Assigned to @elliot. Please update with account IDs and contact emails by EOD.

elliot: on it. will have a preliminary list in the ticket in 2 hours. If customers opted out of incident emails previously, i'll flag that.

maria: legal/contract note: any document that includes internal mitigation steps or non-public timelines must be gated and reviewed. We can provide a redacted public summary immediately, but for full RCA distribution allow 72 hours for legal review for regulated accounts.

arun: thanks. Proposed policy: public status page + short summary (owner: lina) within 2 hours; targeted customer email (owner: sam/support) within same business day; full RCA to customers with NDA/regulatory need (owner: maria) within 72h after review. Also link every action item to our Action Tracker/JIRA. Agree?

lina: agree. Draft status blurb I'll post in a minute: ```Status: Reduced API availability, ~45m window on 2026-03-23 UTC. Impact: increased latency and intermittent errors. Mitigation applied; permanent fix in progress. Postmortem: https://redwood.example.com/postmortems/INC-4321```

sam: good. For the customer email template i'll use bullets: outage window, observable impact, what we did immediately, ETA for fix, next steps, who to contact. Keep root cause phrasing non-sensitive: "engineering regression related to retry/backoff handling."

maria: add line: "If you require an audited technical report for compliance, reply and we'll coordinate a reviewed copy." That avoids accidental over-sharing.

arun: jess (not here) listed remediation tasks in the PM. We need concrete owners/timestamps in Action Tracker. Who will own implementation and verification?

jess: (joins) i'll own remediation delivery. Actions I see: revert bad change + confirm metrics (48h), canary rollout + alerting (72h), CI regression test (7 days). I'll put JIRA PM-789 items and link to the PM.

elliot: i'll add an "incident recurrence" note in the PM citing the Jan regression pattern, and add recommended customer-facing language for sales/support.

arun: good. Two operational asks: 1) support to tag enterprise accounts so custops can route the detailed reports, 2) ops to capture deploy/rollback logs we can attach to full RCAs.

support-bot: SUP-1156 updated with tags; please review.

ops-bot: Deploy job depl-982 started for rollback. Command: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-service --to-revision=203`. Logs streaming -> /var/log/deploys/depl-982.log

sam: hold on customer emails until ops-bot confirms rollback success, otherwise customers will get conflicting messages.

jess: rollback succeeded. I'll post verification metrics in PM and update PM-789.

lina: posting status page update now with the approved blurb.

arun: final reminder: capture everything in the Action Tracker with owners + ETA, and set a recurring review in 2 weeks to check for regressions. Also adding a note to Sales playbook with suggested phrasing about recurrence risk and mitigation roadmap.

maria: i'll review any expanded reports before they go out. Ping me on the SUP ticket when ready.

arun: thanks everyone. i'll close this thread once all Action Tracker items have owners and SUP-1156 is populated. Reopen here if blockers. :thumbsup:
